prompt: Reskin image 1, the floor-free authored 3D floating treasure-orb capture, into a finished hand-painted magical treasure orb. Image 2 is only an auxiliary ground registration square: it establishes the ground root below the floating orb and must not appear in output. Replace the plain primitive surface with a rich translucent turquoise magical gem, readable internal facets and delicate gold filigree, bright controlled highlights and small jewel-like decorative details. You may refine its local gem/filigree silhouette into finished artwork while keeping the same overall size, height, centered position and lowest support/clearance limit; do not enlarge it with a crown, wings, rays or outer glow. Keep the modeled floating pose and scale: the orb is 64px tall at runtime, half one 128px cell width, with its lowest point 48px above the ground-center root. The root remains below the orb at runtime (96,248); do not recenter the orb onto that root or add a stand. Preserve square-grid top-down oblique projection, fixed reference camera, full 384x640 reference canvas and 3:5 aspect, transparent margins and original placement. Return one complete isolated floating treasure orb on genuine transparency; no floor, shadow, stand, glow halo, labels or other objects.

referenceRoles.references/ground-registration.png: auxiliary ground placement and scale registration; excluded from output
